name: Improve Context & Memory
description: Evidence-driven improvement of project context completeness, core memory accuracy, and fact persistence.

steps.title: Audit completeness
steps.description: Read all project documents and last 10 mission outputs per project. Extract discovered facts. Cross-reference: which are persisted, which are missing. Score completeness per project.
steps.accept_criteria: Completeness scores. Missing facts listed with source missions.

steps.title: Backfill and clean
steps.description: Using work-management skill (project-manage add-context): persist missing facts. Using memory-consolidate skill: remove stale/duplicate core memory entries. Generalize before persisting.
steps.accept_criteria: Gaps backfilled. Stale entries removed. Completeness improved.

steps.title: Verify recall
steps.description: Send test mission requiring the backfilled facts. Verify agent uses persisted context without re-discovery.
steps.accept_criteria: Zero re-discovery in test mission output.
